alerts.name: GPU XID 错误

queries.promql: DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 32 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 38 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 48 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 61 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 62 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 63 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 64 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 68 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 74 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 79 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 92 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 94 or DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS == 95

alerts.action:
1) 用 nvidia-smi -q -d PAGE_RETIREMENT,ECC 与 dmesg -T | grep -i xid 确认具体 XID 码和涉及的卡；
2) 对照 NVIDIA XID 文档判断是软件（驱动/CUDA）还是硬件故障；
3) Xid 48/63/64（ECC）与 79（掉卡）基本可判定硬件问题，先把该卡从调度池摘除（K8s 上给节点打 taint）；
4) 软件类的升级驱动/CUDA 后复测，硬件类的走返修流程。

alerts.name: GPU 温度过高
alerts.action:
1) 用 nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,PERFORMANCE 确认当前温度与是否已触发 SW/HW Slowdown；
2) 检查机箱风道、风扇转速与滤网积灰，确认机房进风温度正常；
3) 多卡机型确认是否所有卡都高温——单卡高温多为散热器接触或风扇问题；
4) 短期可用 nvidia-smi -pl 降低功耗上限或降低任务并发，为停机除尘争取时间。

metrics.name: GPU利用率
metrics.note: 表示GPU利用率，即在一个周期时间内（1s或1/6s，根据GPU产品而定），一个或多个核函数处于Active的时间。该指标仅能够展示有核函数在用的GPU资源，但无法展示具体的使用情况。
metrics.note_en: Indicates GPU utilization, which refers to the time that one or more kernel functions are in the Active state within a cycle (1s or 1/6s, depending on the GPU product). This metric can only show the GPU resources used by kernel functions, but cannot display the specific usage details.

metrics.name: 内存带宽利用率
metrics.note: 表示内存带宽利用率。以英伟达GPU V100为例，其最大内存带宽为900 GB/sec，如果当前的内存带宽为450 GB/sec，则内存带宽利用率为50%。
metrics.note_en: Indicates memory bandwidth utilization. For example, the maximum memory bandwidth of NVIDIA GPU V100 is 900 GB/sec; if the current memory bandwidth is 450 GB/sec, the memory bandwidth utilization is 50%.

metrics.name: 编码器利用率
metrics.note: 表示编码器利用率。
metrics.note_en: Indicates encoder utilization.

metrics.name: 解码器利用率
metrics.note: 表示解码器利用率。
metrics.note_en: Indicates decoder utilization.

metrics.name: 帧缓存剩余数
metrics.note: 表示帧缓存（Framebuffer Memory）剩余数。说明：帧缓存一般也被称为显存。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the free amount of Framebuffer Memory. Note: Framebuffer Memory is generally also referred to as video memory.

metrics.name: 帧缓存已使用数
metrics.note: 表示帧缓存已使用数。该值与nvidia-smi命令中Memory-Usage的已使用值对应。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the used amount of Framebuffer Memory. This value corresponds to the used value of Memory-Usage in the nvidia-smi command.

metrics.name: 图形/计算引擎活跃时间占比
metrics.note: 表示在一个时间间隔内，Graphics或Compute引擎处于Active的时间占比。该值表示所有Graphics和Compute引擎的平均值。Graphics或Compute引擎处于Active是指Graphics或Compute Context绑定到线程，并且Graphics或Compute Context处于Busy状态。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the proportion of time that the Graphics or Compute engine is in the Active state within a time interval. This value represents the average of all Graphics and Compute engines. A Graphics or Compute engine is in the Active state when the Graphics or Compute Context is bound to a thread and the Graphics or Compute Context is in the Busy state.

metrics.name: SM活跃时间占比
metrics.note: 表示在一个时间间隔内，至少一个线程束在一个SM（Streaming Multiprocessor）上处于Active的时间占比。该值表示所有SM的平均值，且该值对每个块的线程数不敏感。线程束处于Active是指一个线程束被调度且分配资源后的状态，可能是在Computing、也可能是非Computing状态（例如等待内存请求）。该值小于0.5表示未高效利用GPU，大于0.8是必要的。假设一个GPU有N个SM：一个核函数在整个时间间隔内使用N个线程块运行在所有的SM上，此时该值为1（100%）。一个核函数在一个时间间隔内运行N/5个线程块，此时该值为0.2。一个核函数使用N个线程块，在一个时间间隔内，仅运行了1/5个周期的时间，此时该值为0.2。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the proportion of time that at least one warp is in the Active state on a Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) within a time interval. This value represents the average of all SMs and is not sensitive to the number of threads per block. A warp is in the Active state when it is scheduled and allocated resources, which may be in the Computing state or non-Computing state (e.g., waiting for a memory request). A value less than 0.5 indicates inefficient GPU utilization, and a value greater than 0.8 is necessary. Assume a GPU has N SMs: if a kernel function runs N thread blocks on all SMs for the entire time interval, the value is 1 (100%). If a kernel function runs N/5 thread blocks within a time interval, the value is 0.2. If a kernel function uses N thread blocks but only runs for 1/5 of the cycle within a time interval, the value is 0.2.

metrics.name: SM线程束占用率
metrics.note: 表示在一个时间间隔内，驻留在SM上的线程束与该SM最大可驻留线程束的比例。该值表示一个时间间隔内的所有SM的平均值。占用率越高不代表GPU使用率越高。只有在GPU内存带宽受限的工作负载（DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE）情况下，更高的占用率表示更有效的GPU使用率。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the ratio of warps resident on an SM to the maximum number of warps that can reside on the SM within a time interval. This value represents the average of all SMs over a time interval. A higher occupancy does not mean a higher GPU utilization rate. Only in the case of workloads limited by GPU memory bandwidth (DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE), a higher occupancy indicates a more effective GPU utilization rate.

metrics.name: Tensor管道活跃周期占比
metrics.note: 表示Tensor（HMMA/IMMA） Pipe处于Active状态的周期分数。该值表示一个时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。较高的值表示Tensor Cores的利用率较高。该值为1（100%）表示在整个时间间隔内每隔一个指令周期发出一个Tensor指令（两个周期完成一条指令）。假设该值为0.2（20%），可能有如下情况：在整个时间间隔内，有20%的SM的Tensor Core以100%的利用率运行。在整个时间间隔内，有100%的SM的Tensor Core以20%的利用率运行。在整个时间间隔的1/5时间内，有100%的SM上的Tensor Core以100%利用率运行。其他组合模式。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the fraction of cycles that the Tensor (HMMA/IMMA) Pipe is in the Active state. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. A higher value indicates higher utilization of Tensor Cores. A value of 1 (100%) means a Tensor instruction is issued every other instruction cycle throughout the time interval (one instruction is completed in two cycles). Assuming the value is 0.2 (20%), possible scenarios include: 20% of the SMs' Tensor Cores run at 100% utilization throughout the time interval; 100% of the SMs' Tensor Cores run at 20% utilization throughout the time interval; 100% of the SMs' Tensor Cores run at 100% utilization for 1/5 of the time interval; other combination modes.

metrics.name: FP64管道活跃周期占比
metrics.note: 表示FP64（双精度）Pipe处于Active状态的周期分数。该值表示一个时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。较高的值代表FP64 Cores有较高的利用率。该值为 1（100%）表示在整个时间间隔内上每四个周期（以Volta类型卡为例）执行一次FP64指令。假设该值为0.2（20%），可能有如下情况：在整个时间间隔内，有20%的SM的FP64 Core以100%的利用率运行。在整个时间间隔内，有100%的SM的FP64 Core以20%的利用率运行。在整个时间间隔的1/5时间内，有100%的SM上的FP64 Core以100%利用率运行。其他组合模式。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the fraction of cycles that the FP64 (Double Precision) Pipe is in the Active state. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. A higher value indicates higher utilization of FP64 Cores. A value of 1 (100%) means an FP64 instruction is executed every four cycles (taking Volta-type cards as an example) throughout the time interval. Assuming the value is 0.2 (20%), possible scenarios include: 20% of the SMs' FP64 Cores run at 100% utilization throughout the time interval; 100% of the SMs' FP64 Cores run at 20% utilization throughout the time interval; 100% of the SMs' FP64 Cores run at 100% utilization for 1/5 of the time interval; other combination modes.

metrics.name: FP32管道活跃周期占比
metrics.note: 表示乘加操作FMA（Fused Multiply-Add）管道处于Active的周期分数，乘加操作包括FP32（单精度）和整数。该值表示一个时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。较高的值代表FP32 Cores有较高的利用率。该值为1（100%）表示在整个时间间隔内上每两个周期（Volta类型卡为例）执行一次FP32指令。假设该值为0.2（20%），可能有如下情况：在整个时间间隔内，有20%的SM的FP32 Core以100%的利用率运行。在整个时间间隔内，有100%的SM的FP32 Core以20%的利用率运行。在整个时间间隔的1/5时间内，有100%的SM上的FP32 Core以100%利用率运行。其他组合模式。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the fraction of cycles that the Fused Multiply-Add (FMA) pipe is in the Active state, where FMA operations include FP32 (Single Precision) and integers. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. A higher value indicates higher utilization of FP32 Cores. A value of 1 (100%) means an FP32 instruction is executed every two cycles (taking Volta-type cards as an example) throughout the time interval. Assuming the value is 0.2 (20%), possible scenarios include: 20% of the SMs' FP32 Cores run at 100% utilization throughout the time interval; 100% of the SMs' FP32 Cores run at 20% utilization throughout the time interval; 100% of the SMs' FP32 Cores run at 100% utilization for 1/5 of the time interval; other combination modes.

metrics.name: FP16管道活跃周期占比
metrics.note: 表示FP16（半精度）管道处于Active的周期分数。该值表示一个时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。较高的值代表FP16 Cores有较高的利用率。该值为 1 (100%) 表示在整个时间间隔内上每两个周期（Volta类型卡为例）执行一次FP16指令。假设该值为0.2（20%），可能有如下情况：在整个时间间隔内，有20%的SM的FP16 Core以100%的利用率运行。在整个时间间隔内，有100%的SM的FP16 Core以20%的利用率运行。在整个时间间隔的1/5时间内，有100%的SM上的FP16 Core以100%利用率运行。其他组合模式。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the fraction of cycles that the FP16 (Half Precision) pipe is in the Active state. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. A higher value indicates higher utilization of FP16 Cores. A value of 1 (100%) means an FP16 instruction is executed every two cycles (taking Volta-type cards as an example) throughout the time interval. Assuming the value is 0.2 (20%), possible scenarios include: 20% of the SMs' FP16 Cores run at 100% utilization throughout the time interval; 100% of the SMs' FP16 Cores run at 20% utilization throughout the time interval; 100% of the SMs' FP16 Cores run at 100% utilization for 1/5 of the time interval; other combination modes.

metrics.name: DRAM活跃周期占比
metrics.note: 表示内存带宽利用率（Memory BW Utilization）将数据发送到设备内存或从设备内存接收数据的周期分数。该值表示时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。较高的值表示设备内存的利用率较高。该值为1（100%）表示在整个时间间隔内的每个周期执行一条 DRAM 指令（实际上，峰值约为 0.8 (80%) 是可实现的最大值）。假设该值为0.2（20%），表示20%的周期在时间间隔内读取或写入设备内存。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the fraction of cycles for memory bandwidth utilization (Memory BW Utilization) to send data to or receive data from device memory. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. A higher value indicates higher utilization of device memory. A value of 1 (100%) means a DRAM instruction is executed in each cycle throughout the time interval (in practice, a peak of about 0.8 (80%) is the maximum achievable value). Assuming the value is 0.2 (20%), it means 20% of the cycles are used to read or write device memory within the time interval.

metrics.name: PCIe发送数据速率
metrics.note: 表示通过PCIe总线传输的数据速率，包括协议标头和数据有效负载。该值表示一个时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。该速率在时间间隔内平均。例如，在1秒内传输1 GB数据，则无论以恒定速率还是突发传输数据，速率都是1 GB/s。理论上的最大PCIe Gen3带宽为每通道985 MB/s。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the data rate transmitted over the PCIe bus, including protocol headers and data payloads. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. The rate is averaged over the time interval. For example, if 1 GB of data is transmitted in 1 second, the rate is 1 GB/s regardless of whether the data is transmitted at a constant rate or in bursts. The theoretical maximum PCIe Gen3 bandwidth is 985 MB/s per lane.

metrics.name: PCIe接收数据速率
metrics.note: 表示通过PCIe总线接收的数据速率，包括协议标头和数据有效负载。该值表示一个时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。该速率在时间间隔内平均。例如，在1秒内传输1 GB数据，则无论以恒定速率还是突发传输数据，速率都是1 GB/s。理论上的最大PCIe Gen3带宽为每通道985 MB/s。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the data rate received over the PCIe bus, including protocol headers and data payloads. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. The rate is averaged over the time interval. For example, if 1 GB of data is transmitted in 1 second, the rate is 1 GB/s regardless of whether the data is transmitted at a constant rate or in bursts. The theoretical maximum PCIe Gen3 bandwidth is 985 MB/s per lane.

metrics.name: NVLink接收数据速率
metrics.note: 表示通过NVLink传输的数据速率，不包括协议标头。该值表示一个时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。该速率在时间间隔内平均。例如，在1秒内传输1 GB数据，则无论以恒定速率还是突发传输数据，速率都是1 GB/s。理论上，最大NVLink Gen2带宽为每个方向每个链路25 GB/s。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the data rate received over NVLink, excluding protocol headers. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. The rate is averaged over the time interval. For example, if 1 GB of data is transmitted in 1 second, the rate is 1 GB/s regardless of whether the data is transmitted at a constant rate or in bursts. Theoretically, the maximum NVLink Gen2 bandwidth is 25 GB/s per link in each direction.

metrics.name: NVLink发送数据速率
metrics.note: 表示通过NVLink接收的数据速率，不包括协议标头。该值表示一个时间间隔内的平均值，而不是瞬时值。该速率在时间间隔内平均。例如，在1秒内传输1 GB数据，则无论以恒定速率还是突发传输数据，速率都是1 GB/s。理论上，最大NVLink Gen2带宽为每个方向每个链路25 GB/s。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the data rate transmitted over NVLink, excluding protocol headers. This value represents the average over a time interval, not an instantaneous value. The rate is averaged over the time interval. For example, if 1 GB of data is transmitted in 1 second, the rate is 1 GB/s regardless of whether the data is transmitted at a constant rate or in bursts. Theoretically, the maximum NVLink Gen2 bandwidth is 25 GB/s per link in each direction.

metrics.name: SM时钟频率
metrics.note: 表示SM时钟频率。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the SM clock frequency.

metrics.name: 内存时钟频率
metrics.note: 表示内存时钟频率。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the memory clock frequency.

metrics.name: SM应用时钟频率
metrics.note: 表示SM应用时钟频率。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the SM application clock frequency.

metrics.name: 内存应用时钟频率
metrics.note: 表示内存应用时钟频率。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the memory application clock frequency.

metrics.name: 时钟降频原因
metrics.note: 表示时钟慢下来的原因。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the reasons for the clock slowing down.

metrics.name: XID错误号
metrics.note: 表示一段时间内，最后发生的XID错误号。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the last XID error number that occurred over a period of time.

metrics.name: 功率上限违规时长
metrics.note: 表示因功率上限而导致的违规，该值为违规的时间。
metrics.note_en: Indicates violations caused by power caps, and this value is the duration of the violation.

metrics.name: 热限制违规时长
metrics.note: 表示由于热限制导致的违规，该值为违规的时间。
metrics.note_en: Indicates violations caused by thermal limits, and this value is the duration of the violation.

metrics.name: 同步提升限制违规时长
metrics.note: 表示由于同步提升限制而导致的违规，该值为违规的时间。
metrics.note_en: Indicates violations caused by sync boost limits, and this value is the duration of the violation.

metrics.name: 电路板限制违规时长
metrics.note: 表示由于电路板限制而导致的违规，该值为违规的时间。
metrics.note_en: Indicates violations caused by board limits, and this value is the duration of the violation.

metrics.name: 低利用率限制违规时长
metrics.note: 表示低利用率限制导致的违规，该值为违规的时间。
metrics.note_en: Indicates violations caused by low utilization limits, and this value is the duration of the violation.

metrics.name: 电路板可靠性限制违规时长
metrics.note: 表示电路板可靠性限制导致违规，该值为违规的时间。
metrics.note_en: Indicates violations caused by board reliability limits, and this value is the duration of the violation.

metrics.name: 已使用的BAR1
metrics.note: 表示已使用的BAR1。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the used amount of BAR1.

metrics.name: 剩余的BAR1
metrics.note: 表示剩余的BAR1。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the free amount of BAR1.

metrics.name: 内存温度
metrics.note: 表示内存温度。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the memory temperature.

metrics.name: GPU温度
metrics.note: 表示GPU温度。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the GPU temperature.

metrics.name: GPU功率
metrics.note: 表示功率。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the power consumption.

metrics.name: 总能耗
metrics.note: 表示从驱动加载开始，已消耗的能量。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the total energy consumed since the driver was loaded.

metrics.name: 单bit错误停用页面数
metrics.name_en: Retired Pages due to Single-bit Errors
metrics.note: 表示由单bit错误而停用的页面。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the pages retired due to single-bit errors.

metrics.name: 双bit错误停用页面数
metrics.name_en: Retired Pages due to Double-bit Errors
metrics.note: 表示用双bit错误而停用的页面。
metrics.note_en: Indicates the pages retired due to double-bit errors.

collect.content:
[[instances]]
# 指定使用的指标定义文件, 一般使用 default-counters.csv就够了，也可以尝试用其他两个csv文件
# path to the file, that contains the DCGM fields to collect
  collectors = "conf/input.dcgm/default-counters.csv"

# 是否是K8s环境，设置为true会附件Pod的信息
# Enable kubernetes mapping metrics to kubernetes pods
# kubernetes=false

# 指标中是否附加 gpu id 作为一个标签
# Choose Type of GPU ID to use to map kubernetes resources to pods. Possible values: "uid", "device-name"
# kubernetes-gpu-id-type = "uid"

# 是否使用 1.x 的ns
# Use old 1.x namespace
# use-old-namespace = false

# 支持的选项是f g i 
# f: FlexKey 如果MIG被禁用，则监控所有GPU；如果MIG被启用，则监控所有GPU实例
# g: MajorKey 监控top-level entities：GPU或NvSwitches或CPU 
# i: MinorKey 监控sub-level entities: GPU实例/NvLinks/CPU核心 - 如果MIG被禁用，则不能指定该选项
  cpu-devices = "f"

# 与cpu-devices的选项一样
# gpu devices
  devices = "f"

# 与cpu-devices的选项一样
  switch-devices = "f"

# 使用ConfigMap 
# ConfigMap <NAMESPACE>:<NAME> for metric data
  configmap-data = "none"

# 这里就是前置依赖的nvidia-dcgm服务, 如果是本机采集，则使用localhost:5555 ,如果是远程采集，则使用远端IP:5555
# Connect to remote hostengine at <HOST>:<PORT>
  remote-hostengine-info = "localhost:5555"

# 允许用户在没有实际GPU硬件的环境中模拟GPU, 仅用于测试
# Accept GPUs that are fake, for testing purposes only
# fake-gpus = false

# 将GPU型号名称中的每个空格替换为破折号，确保标识符连续且无空格。 
# Replaces every blank space in the GPU model name with a dash, ensuring a continuous, space-free identifier.
# replace-blanks-in-model-name = false

# # collect interval
# interval = 15

# exec local command
# e.g. nvidia_smi_command = "nvidia-smi"
nvidia_smi_command = ""

# exec remote command
# nvidia_smi_command = "ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null SSH_USER@SSH_HOST nvidia-smi"

# Comma-separated list of the query fields.
# You can find out possible fields by running `nvidia-smi --help-query-gpu`.
# The value `AUTO` will automatically detect the fields to query.
query_field_names = "AUTO"
